# Anees Munir Khokhar — AI Engineer Profile

> AI Engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan, specializing in production-grade Agentic AI systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, computer vision systems, and microservice APIs.

## Core Specializations
- **Agentic AI & Orchestration:** Multi-Agent Workflows, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP Server Development, Autonomous Agents.
- **RAG & Vector Retrieval:** Hybrid Retrieval (FAISS, Scikit-Learn TF-IDF), Document Ingestion (PDF, YouTube, Web), LangChain, Embedding Pipelines.
- **Generative AI & LLMs:** Llama-3.3, Groq Cloud API, OpenAI API, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama local model routing, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning.
- **Computer Vision & Deep Learning:** YOLOv11, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Object Detection, Image Classification, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras.
- **Backend & MLOps:** FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Pytest regression testing.
